programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The final expedition begins, as the Fara Heim crew search for physical proof of the lost Viking quest over 500 years ago. A trapper's letter and map from 1929 may hold the key to what happened to the Viking travelers. On the map is a stone cairn, perhaps holding the remains of a member of the lost Vikings. But is the old map accurate? And can they reach the cairn site as bears, weather, and an unforgiving landscape ruin their best laid plans.

programs.title: Secret Societies: In the Shadows
programs.desc: What started as a Bavarian group of revolutionaries hellbent on infiltrating powerful institutions has now become the stuff of legend, and some claim this elite group continues to control power from behind closed doors.
